scenario: A rheumatologist prepares a preconception risk assessment for an SLE/APS patient. Raw laboratory and clinical data are cleaned and standardized by clinical-data-cleaner, the normalized dataset is fed into pregna-risk to compute the composite adverse-pregnancy-outcome score and risk category, and health-report assembles the findings into a structured clinician-facing summary.
info_flow: clinical-data-cleaner normalizes the raw patient record (labs, boolean clinical flags) into a clean dataset → pregna-risk maps the normalized fields to its risk-factor schema and computes a weighted composite score with risk category → health-report formats the score, category, and monitoring recommendations into a structured clinical summary.
